x2_operational_negatives.candidate_workaround: Classify the builder's scanner-definition self-match as a declared scanner false positive, require zero confirmed stale paths, and bind top-level validity to that gate.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_observed: One scanner self-hit was written as confirmed while the aggregate remained valid; no commit, network call, authority action, or external mutation occurred.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_procedure: Run the first evidence builder with an undifferentiated scanner over its own pattern source.
x2_operational_negatives.failure_signature: The first x2 build matched the stale-label scanner's own pattern definition, wrote an invalid stale-label receipt, but still marked the top-level evidence receipt valid; the whole attempt earned zero aggregate credit.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_observed: The corrected stale-label gate reports zero confirmed stale paths and the aggregate validity is bound to that result.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_procedure: Exclude only the exact scanner-definition file from confirmed-label classification, record the false positive, and require the corrected component receipt to be valid before aggregate success.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Separate raw scanner hits from confirmed stale labels and make every component validity state a prerequisite of the aggregate receipt.
x2_operational_negatives.scope_boundary: Owner-local validation-consistency recovery only; no completion, professional, legal, cultural, route, or authority credit.
